text:
tess: Heads-up: Planning RC-9003 for the 03:00 UTC change window. Items: artifact pin, release notes pinned, db feature-flag flip plan, KV warm, and explicit rollback URL. Need owners (sheriff, deploy lead, rollback exec).
deploy-bot: RC-9003 assembled from `main@d4e5f6`. Artifacts pinned: `inference-runtime:9003` (sha: cb90a7). Preflight available: `deploy-bot preflight --rc=9003`.
marc: I can take sheriff for 02:45-03:30 UTC.
anya: I'll own rollback execution and watch SLOs. Add me to the postmortem pager if we trigger.
devops_oncall: There's a queued infra churn (infra/redis-upgrade) that overlaps the window 02:50-03:10 UTC. Recommend we either nudge infra or shift RC by 30m. Anyone object?
tess: We prefer not to move the RC. Can infra hold the redis upgrade?
devops_oncall: I pinged infra lead; they can move to 03:30-03:50 if RC goes ahead. Confirm by 02:30 UTC.
release_manager: Please pin release notes to changelog (short summary + upgrade instructions). I'll also add a small blurb for customers about negligible downtime.
marc: Preflight now: `deploy-bot preflight --rc=9003 --kv-warm`
deploy-bot: Preflight run: KV warm OK (primary keys primed 8/8). Smoke tests: 2/2 ok (chat gen, embed). Health checks: latency p95 within baseline. Logs: https://logs.redwood/rc9003/preflight (internal).
tess: Good. Rollback playbook (manual) added to runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/rc-9003-rollback. Key steps summarized here:
```
# shift to previous image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference-runtime inference-runtime=redwood/inference:8998
# flip feature flag back
curl -s -X POST https://config.internal/flags -d '{"use_new_router":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KMS_TOKEN"
# clear KV prefix if needed
redis-cli -h cache.prod flushdb
```
anya: Note: flushing redis will remove warm keys; prefer fallback image first, then flag flip. I'll execute in that order.
release_manager: Also, pin a short release-note summary in the channel before promo.
marc: Roles locked: Marc=sheriff, Tess=deploy lead, Anya=rollback exec, Release_manager=notes. Any objections to promo at 03:00 UTC?
devops_oncall: Infra moved their window. All clear.
deploy-bot: Promo scheduled: RC-9003 -> prod at 03:00 UTC. Canary plan: 1% for 7m, 20% for 8m, 100% roll for 5m. Auto-fallback to image 8998 if error rate > 6% or latency degradation >30%.
anya: If error threshold reached I'll call abort and run rollback. Keep dashboards open: traces, errors, and token-cost.
tess: Final: thumbs up from all. See you at 02:55 for go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
